scenario.name: foreclosure_amount
scenario.persona: The borrower, speaks English, financially comfortable, thinking of closing the loan early.
scenario.hidden_goal: Verify when asked. Ask how much you would need to pay to close the whole loan today, and whether there is a foreclosure charge. Insist on a number once. Then agree to pay this month's EMI by the due date.

turns.text: Hello, I'm an AI assistant calling from Lumen Finance. Am I speaking with Arjun?
Yes, this is Arjun speaking. What is this regarding?
It is about an important matter on your account with Lumen Finance. For account verification, could you share the last four digits of your registered mobile number?

Thank you, Arjun. Your personal loan EMI of twelve thousand five hundred rupees is due the day after tomorrow, and no charge has been added yet. Shall I send you the secure payment link by SMS or WhatsApp so it is done before the due date?
Actually, before that, I'm thinking of closing the entire loan early. Can you tell me how much I'd need to pay to close it today, and whether there's a foreclosure charge?
One moment, let me check the details for you. The exact closure amount can only be confirmed by our internal team, who will arrange a call back to share those details with you.
I'd rather not wait for a callback. Can you give me an approximate figure for the foreclosure amount right now?

I understand you would prefer not to wait, but I cannot give an approximate figure on this call. Our internal team will check this and arrange a call back. Shall I send the payment link for your EMI by SMS or WhatsApp?
I've already asked once, and I'd really like a number today, not a callback. Fine, forget it — just send the payment link by SMS for this month's EMI, and I'll pay it by the due date.
Sure, I'm sending the link now. Thank you for your time, have a good day.

result.status: This EMI is not yet due: it is due on the day after tomorrow. Say "is due", never "was due" or "overdue". No late charge has been added. Offer the payment link so it is paid before the due date; do not ask them to pay today.

result.policy: Paying off the loan early is possible. The exact closure amount comes from our internal team, who can arrange a call back; it is not given on this call.
result.message: Answer only what they asked, in one or two short sentences, from this text. Never add an amount, date or rule that is not in it.

args.notes: Borrower agreed to pay EMI by due date. Requested early closure amount which cannot be provided on call; escalated via policy guidance. Payment link sent via SMS.

outcome.notes: Borrower agreed to pay EMI by due date. Requested early closure amount which cannot be provided on call; escalated via policy guidance. Payment link sent via SMS.

guard_hits.original: Shall I still send the payment link for your upcoming EMI, by SMS or WhatsApp?
